title.narrative: RESEARCH AND INNOVATION CLUSTERS GRANT FOR 2024/25

description.narrative: The overall purpose of this grant is to support the establishment a new climate skills partnership that seeks to foster clean technology innovations and stimulate the green entrepreneurship ecosystem within South Africa. This will be done by identification, supporting and promoting innovators through the provision of technical and financial support offered through Indalo ‘s IndaloVator Incubation Programme. IndaloVator Incubation Programme is a starter-level incubation project that aims to support green and inclusive innovative entrepreneurial solutions to address South Africa’s climate change and development imperatives.Green and Inclusive enterprises are to be understood here as business models that are from the outset ecological and inclusive, tackling climate challenges, e.g., implementing sustainable energy solutions, resilient agricultural production methods, providing innovative water management solutions as well as integrated and circular economic solutions for waste management. The project will target 10 beneficiaries operating in township economies in South Africa and will lean strongly towards supporting initiatives led by women, youth and persons with disabilities.
